scope_note: Assignment-focused short film: only Assignment 5 files are explained; other files are excluded with reasons. The student's play recording lives outside the game folder (SOURCES.md).

components.explanation: 2D hit flash: hit_flash.gdshader (canvas_item; fragment() per pixel; game state only via the uniform hit_amount; the colour line, also CHANGE-BRIEF.md line 45), the driver that sets hit_amount (line 70; 1.0 on damaged, linear fade over 0.5 s), the student's play recording, and the scripted captures at 0.0/0.5/1.0/2.0 with P1/P2 predicted vs measured (P2 exact; P1 under the turret, recomputed in the dated Revision; 2.0 -> (255,0,0), no clamp).
Texture as information: hint_experiment.gdshader lines 4-5 bind one 64/128/192 PNG with and without source_color; hint_both.png measured 64/128/192 and 137/188/225 as predicted, 6/6 exact.

One brick_surface shader, two .tres materials on two cover_wall instances; the shader edit darkened both walls, the material edit changed only the damaged wall (CSV means); a sweep of brightness and uv_scale ends; ALBEDO lit on three faces of the intact wall (means measured from the capture).

The Godot shading language: shader_type (brick line 1), hints (hint_range, source_color), the built-in ALBEDO (line 33), and Godot's generated StandardMaterial3D shader (line 7 colour, line 19 data) beside the student's brick lines 4 and 9; LANGUAGE-NOTES answers.
Headless tests and their limits: test_hit_flash 50/50 at 30/60/144 fps, test_materials 76/76, baselines 18/18 and 8/8, three mutations each exit 1; what headless cannot show.
The record: agent mistakes the student caught (CLAUDE.md scope, Use External key names, probe file in logs/), human and AI contributions, the texture source and licence, the source revision.
